result.neutralNegativeScope: Only the simulated attacks; finishers/sliding/zoom outside this scenario have no damage contribution.

stages.coarse: all traits, same equipped MOD context, panel ordering only
stages.beam: fair 2/3-positive structures, neutral negatives and legal duration rolls; width 8
stages.refined: keep 7..0 capacity fallback; no forced deletion for ranking

recommend-basis: 当前 MOD 卡池加入紫卡后的合法配装；已装备赋能与已建模 MOD 触发按满状态计算，显式层数/覆盖率仍按输入
